# teamtailor fixtures

Real response from a public, unauthenticated endpoint (one request, User-Agent
`RumoJobSearch/0.1.0 (uso pessoal)`), captured on 2026-11-14.

- URL: https://kompan.teamtailor.com/jobs.rss
- file(s): jobs.rss
- original size: 127,168 bytes
- original items: 16 items
- kept: first 5 items (copied as text)

Trimming: item objects are unmodified (re-serialised as indented UTF-8 JSON).
E-mail addresses inside the data are replaced by `removido@example.test`. No personal
data of candidates.

Robots (https://kompan.teamtailor.com/robots.txt, 200): `User-Agent: *` disallows only /app/, /messages/, /messenger/, /facebook/tab/, /jobs/internal/ (so /jobs.rss is allowed). Company: kompan, found by web search.
